scope: Read-only public JJIntern product exploration in a fresh isolated logged-out Chrome profile. No account, employer-handoff, application, saved state, private data or external publication.

sources.method: Web open; public homepage positioning and explicit illustrative disclosures read
sources.limitation: Marketing descriptions are not operation tests.

sources.method: Actual theme toggle and text input events. Microsoft search narrowed the directory to Microsoft.
Actual Tech and Finance category clicks produced distinct settled role sets.

sources.limitation: No scheduler, run logs, delivery or latency verification.

recommended_strengths.strength: Finance and technology discovery in one feed
recommended_strengths.proof: Fresh public all-role, Tech and Finance states; homepage explicitly positions Singapore finance and tech internships.
recommended_strengths.boundary: No complete coverage, employer-confirmed availability or accurate classification guarantee. Do not call a shown historical row newly posted. Counts and relative dates are the site's snapshot, not independently verified facts.

recommended_strengths.strength: Search a company and narrow the directory
recommended_strengths.proof: Fresh actual input of Microsoft, one letter at a time, narrowed directory to Microsoft.
recommended_strengths.boundary: Company presence does not imply partnership, endorsement or currently open employer vacancy. Do not imply saved/watchlist persistence from the page title.

recommended_strengths.strength: Choose Finance or Tech to narrow the feed
recommended_strengths.proof: Actual Tech click changed first row from OCBC to Tower Research; actual Finance click changed first row to EY. Different role sets settled before capture.
recommended_strengths.boundary: Only these categories were tested. Role-filter menu, sorting and persistence were not tested in this audit.

permitted_copy: JJIntern checks for internship postings every 30 minutes.
recommended_strengths.boundary: Scheduled checking only. No instant ingestion, max 30-minute arrival, alert timing or complete employer/source coverage. Keep the numerical cadence separated from fast editorial travel or a depicted new vacancy.

recommended_strengths.proof: Fresh isolated logged-out session loaded directory and feed; homepage FAQ explicitly says browsing internships and exploring companies needs no account.
recommended_strengths.boundary: This does not establish free access to every feature, perpetual pricing, signup completion or time to signup.

unsupported_for_this_film: Save, tracking or Telegram operation demos; authenticated persistence/delivery not tested
AI matching, auto-apply, resume scoring or interview coaching
Instant, real time, never miss, every internship or complete coverage
Measured time savings, improved acceptance, salary or hiring outcome
A company tile as evidence of partnership or endorsement
Homepage illustrative roles or application board used as live vacancies or authentic user outcomes

brand.logo_rules: Use original raster with unchanged proportions, colour and silhouette; modest size. No vector trace or invented official wordmark.
brand.font: System sans as defined in brand tokens; no new downloaded substitute.

desktop_capture_crops_native_pixels.purpose: Whole authentic search field and first tile row; aggregate live-role count excluded.
Authentic category/search controls, column labels and first three results; aggregate counters excluded.

portrait_capture_crops_native_pixels.purpose: Whole genuine search field and first complete company tile. 520 CSS viewport at DPR 3.

Genuine mobile layout after actual 125px scroll. All three filter controls and whole first result preserved. Choose height for one or two complete rows according to available film space; source roles are readable and untruncated.

edit_note: Crops may reframe original pixels. Do not remove or replace text within captures, redraw controls or invent a state. The site uses truncation in this viewport; primary film typography carries the benefit while the UI supplies proof.
release_limitations: No publishing performed. Fresh screenshot evidence verifies depicted public interactions only. Physical-phone playback, platform overlay preview, and final rights/asset review remain separate.
